label: Every word on the How to Use screen

params.name: no_project_body
params.default: How to Use hangs off a project’s screens. Register one and scan it, then come back.

params.name: lede
params.default: Every screen of {project}, and the links a reader gets when they press “How to Use” on it — a manual, a YouTube video, a recording, anything with an address.

params.name: no_screens
params.default: This project has no screens yet — scan it in Setup and they appear here.

params.name: reading_title
params.default: Reading these links from your app

params.name: reading_line
params.default: No login, any origin, any framework:

params.name: discard_confirm
params.default: Discard the unsaved links on this screen?

params.name: live_note
params.default: Unticking Live keeps a link here but hides it from readers — the way to retire a video without losing its address.

params.name: live_tip
params.default: Live — unticked stays here but hides from readers

params.name: from_manual
params.default: Published by a manual — re-publishing rewrites this row.

params.name: nothing_body
params.default: A manual section, a YouTube walkthrough, a recording — whatever helps on this screen.

params.name: row_remove_body
params.default: This link comes off the list for this screen. Nothing changes for your readers until you press Save links.

description_nl: The words of one screen. {placeholders} are filled on the page. A language overrides any of them with chip ui.howto.<lang> (for example ui.howto.hi).
